name: Raidenko
shortBackstory: Raidenko controls the battlefield through foxfire and shapeshift geometry — the Inari-source whose misdirection is control without force.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Raidenko was born from the foxfire that leads travelers astray. He is the controller who bends geometry through illusion. Ancient humans saw him as Inari — but they saw the fox and missed the geometry. Raidenko's foxfire is not trickery; it is sacred misdirection.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Kami, Raidenko makes the battlefield impossible for enemies to read. His foxfire creates false paths and phantom objectives. He works with Amaterion — she defines what is sacred, and he makes everything outside look like something else.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Raidenko by making his illusions indistinguishable from reality. The Hollow created genuine absences that looked exactly like his foxfire phantoms. He could no longer tell his misdirection from the enemy's destruction.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Kami Mirror Tempest, Raidenko shapes the battlefield through foxfire geometry. His storm-script sceptre creates phantom terrain. But the Hollow already has genuine absences that look like his phantoms.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Raidenko's flaw is that he has never trusted anything he could not fake. He treats truth as just the most convincing lie. The Hollow teaches him that some absences are not illusions — they are genuine, irreversible losses.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
human_echo: Susanoo's Orochi-slaying was the real storm event humans celebrated; the Kusanagi sword was the real blade found in the serpent's tail
